## Appearance

Diana Barry is characterized by her black eyes, glossy jet-black curls, and crimson, rosy cheeks. Her physical features also include dimples and a plump, dimpled hand.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Personality

Diana is a good, smart, and ladylike girl who possesses a very practical nature. She has notable taste in dressing, often being sought after for advice on the subject, and is skilled at both singing solos and making splendid lettuce salad.

## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born. After meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Diana quickly forms a deep bond with her in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) as they solemnly swear eternal friendship. When her mother temporarily forbids her from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Diana is forced to keep her distance until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saves her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during a severe case of croup, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring their friendship. Later, Diana participates in the school story club, attends the school concert, and brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the joyful news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. The two friends join the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), together canvassing local residents for hall repairs, trying to stop Judson Parker's fence advertisements, and hosting a successful visit for author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). They also discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and meet Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) while lost on a walk to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to resign her teaching position to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Diana grieves her upcoming departure and worries about the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Diana eventually confides her engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the two later help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> “Everything went off very well,” said Diana practically. “I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became quick friends after meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), swearing eternal friendship. Their bond faced a period of strain when Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbade Diana from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but they were reconciled after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) for severe croup. Over time, they grew up together as schoolmates, started a story club, attended concerts, and eventually served as fellow members on the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) committee.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +62 more_

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta the Fourth is a young maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) who acts as a welcoming host alongside her employer when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) get lost in the woods. She entertains Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by demonstrating her echoing tin horn during tea and later works with them as they prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) forms a friendship with Diana after Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lose their way in the woods and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She hosts Diana for an imaginative tea party, welcomes her as a frequent guest, and later relies on Diana to help prepare her home for her wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Shirley](../character/shirley.md) and Diana are close childhood friends who swore an oath of eternal friendship. Their bond remains strong throughout their youth, surviving temporary separations imposed by Diana's mother, and Diana is deeply saddened when [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) resigns her teaching post to attend college. Diana later confides her engagement to [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) and works alongside her to help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for a wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +29 more_
